text:
Nina H: Quick UX check on compact pool card — surge wording, SLO guardrail tooltip position, keyboard flow. Need final copy before dev sprint.
Owen K: I prefer "surge" in the UI; backend remains "burst_quanta". Surge reads clearer.
Priya S: Visual pattern: collapsed "Add surge capacity" button that expands inline. When expanded show "+{n} surge (temporary)" pill. Keeps baseline first.
Liam J: Tooltip for SLO guardrail overlaps cost at <=600px. Anchor tooltip below the slider and add a chevron so it doesn't cover numbers.
Priya S: Keyboard flow: tab order -> pool selector -> Min -> Max -> Add surge -> (expand) focus moves to surge input. Use aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Nina H: Final microcopy (for dev): - Header: "Capacity" - Min label (aria): "Minimum capacity (GPUs)" - Max label (aria): "Maximum capacity (GPUs)" - Surge CTA: "Add surge capacity" - Surge pill: "+{n} surge (temporary)" - Guardrail short: "SLO guardrail 6 caps autoscale to meet latency targets. Learn more."
Liam J: Dev note: convert internal quanta to GPUs server-side; API fields: min_capacity, max_capacity, surge_capacity, surge_ttl_seconds.
A11yBot: Accessibility checklist (copy-paste): "aria-labels on all inputs", "surge toggle has aria-expanded + aria-controls", "focus moves to surge input on expand", "visible focus styles on steppers and chips", "tooltip anchored below slider at small widths"
